name: Ching-Teng Yu (游鏡騰)
positioning: Turning complex problems into workable solutions
summary: I am good at clarifying problems and bringing different needs and resources together. I work from solution design to real use, then test and revise, to turn complex conditions into results that work. I mainly apply this in sustainability, the environment, and education.
logic: Problem and limits → Solution design and integration → Real results

cases.title: Eco Kitchen: Bringing Many Needs and Resources Together
cases.text: The site had an unused outdoor classroom and multiple needs, such as the role of the site and food and farming education. I brought together space, energy, water, and teaching needs, and turned the old space into an outdoor eco kitchen that can keep being used.

cases.title: Elementary School Rainwater System: System Design Under Site Limits
cases.text: The school needed to collect rainwater, with limits on space, pipes, and upkeep. I worked from the site survey and design to on-site assembly and testing, and kept adjusting the system layout. The result is a rainwater collection system that the school can use and students can learn from.

cases.title: Workflow Improvement: Less Repeated Work and Less Admin Load
cases.text: Data was spread out, and staff had to organize it again and make statistics across sheets, which added to the admin load. I reviewed how the data relates and how the work flows, and used existing tools to improve the statistics. Data preparation and chart making for reports went from several hours to about one hour or less (estimated from actual work).

cases.title: Climate Resilience Course Development: Turning an Abstract Topic into Teaching Programs
cases.text: Climate resilience is an abstract topic, and learners have different needs. I helped plan the development structure and bring together team roles and trial-teaching feedback. I was directly in charge of improving two courses and redesigning one new lesson plan, and I helped the team finish six courses that can be taught in real classes.

experience.name: Global Environmental Enhancement Inc.
experience.role: On-site Supervisor | Environmental Education & Sustainability Programs
experience.text: Based at a nature education center, I serve as the on-site supervisor for an annual project of about NT$4.3 million. My work covers program development, site building, work with government agencies, coordination of on-site delivery, managing a five-person on-site team, and handling daily operation problems.

experience.name: Freelance Instructor / Permaculture Design Consultant
experience.text: I help schools and communities with sustainability programs, course development, and site design. I take part in on-site building, teaching, and later adjustments.
